Coverlite

Polycarbonate Panels & Ridgecaps

If you are looking for a high-quality polycarbonate sheet which features the latest in product technology, our Coverlite panels and ridge covers deliver! Offering outstanding characteristics such as high light transmission, advanced UV-protection, and excellent impact resistance, these polycarbonates panels are virtually unbreakable.

Product Features

HIGH LIGHT TRANSMISSION:
Our Coverlite sheets offer a high degree of light transmittance due to its high optical properties with up to 90% light transmission.

VIRTUALLY UNBREAKABLE:
Coverlite polycarbonate sheets are economical and light in weight, yet it’s 10 times stronger than acrylic and 200 times stronger than glass!

MULTIPLE PRODUCT OFFERINGS:
Available in clear or bronze our Coverlite sheets come in PRO-Rib & TUFF-Rib panel profiles as well as a low profile ridge cap.

Specifications

  • Panels come in 8′, 12′ and 16′ lengths.
  • PRO-Rib and TUFF-Rib profiles available.
  • 1.6mm thick for added durability.
  • Ridge caps come in 10’6″ lengths only.
  • Panels and ridge caps available in clear and bronze.
  • Domtek recommends Coverlite panels are not installed when temperatures are below 40F and above 80F.

Applications

  • Greenhouses
  • Vertical Glazings
  • Canopies
  • Sunrooms / Patio Covers
  • Sidelites
  • Metal Buildings
  • Skylights
  • Pool enclosures
  • Carports
